==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Western Provinces" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Take the [[agility shortcut]] from the [[Grand Tree]] to [[Otto's Grotto]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Tree Gnome Village]] and [[The Grand Tree]]
*{{SCP|Agility|37|link=y}}
|-
|2. Travel to the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold|Gnome Stronghold]] by [[Spirit Tree]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Tree Gnome Village]]
|-
|3. Trap a [[Spined Larupia]].
''Note: This creature is found in the [[Feldip Hunter area]].
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|31|link=y}}
*[[Teasing stick]], [[logs]], and a [[knife]]
|-
|4. Fish some [[Raw bass|Bass]] on [[Ape Atoll]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Monkey Madness I]]
*{{SCP|Fishing|46|link=y}}
*[[Big fishing net]]
|-
|5. Chop and burn some [[teak logs]] on [[Ape Atoll]].
''Note: With 50 [[Woodcutting]] and 50 [[Firemaking]], you can also chop and burn some [[mahogany logs]] here for a [[#Hard|hard task]].''

''Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Monkey Madness I]]
*{{SCP|Woodcutting|35|link=y}} and {{SCP|Firemaking|35|link=y}}
*Any [[axe]] and [[tinderbox]]
|-
|6. Complete an intermediate game of [[Pest Control]].
''Note: You must've earnt [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]] for this task to count as completed. In Deadman Mode, the task is instead "Attempt to board the intermediate Pest Control lander with at least 70 combat."''
|
*{{SCP|Combat|70|link=y}}
|-
|7. Travel to the [[Feldip Hills]] by [[Gnome Glider]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Grand Tree]] and partial completion of [[One Small Favour]]
|-
|8. Claim a [[Chompy bird hat]] from [[Rantz]] after registering at least 125 kills.
''Note: You need to have a ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]] in your inventory to claim hats.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]]
*[[Ogre bellows]], ([[comp ogre bow|comp]]) [[ogre bow]], and [[ogre arrows|ogre]] or [[brutal arrows]]
*125 [[chompy bird|chompy]] or [[jubbly bird]] kills
|-
|9. Travel from [[Eagles' Peak (mountain)|Eagles' Peak]] to the [[Feldip Hills]] by [[Eagle transport system|Eagle]].
''Note: You'll unlock travel from the [[Eagles' Peak Dungeon]] after the required quest.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Eagles' Peak]]
*[[Rope]]
|-
|10. Make a [[Chocolate Bomb]] at the [[Grand Tree]].
|
*{{SCP|Cooking|42|link=y}}
*[[Gnomebowl mould]], [[Gianne dough]], 4 [[chocolate bar]]s, an [[Equa leaves|equa leaf]], 2 [[Pot of cream|pots of cream]], and [[chocolate dust]] (can all be purchased at [[Grand Tree Groceries]])
|-
|11. Complete a delivery for the [[Gnome Restaurant]].
|
*Completion of the [[Gnome Restaurant tutorial]]
*{{SCP|Cooking|29-42|link=y}} (varies per food)
|-
|12. Turn your [[Crystal saw seed|small crystal seed]] into a [[Crystal saw]].
''Note: You have to enchant it with the [[singing bowl]] in [[Brimstail's cave]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Eyes of Glouphrie]]
*[[Crystal saw seed]]
|-
|13. Mine some [[Gold ore]] underneath the [[Grand Tree]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Grand Tree]]
*{{SCP|Mining|40|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Western banner 2]]:
**Depicts [[King Awowogei]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 40
*50% chance of two [[chompy bird]]s appearing at once when [[chompy bird hunting]]
*[[Rantz]] offers you 50 [[ogre arrow]]s for free every day, worth a total of {{NoCoins|{{GEP|Ogre arrow|50}}}} [[coins]] on the [[Grand Exchange]]
*The [[crystal saw]] will now hold up to 56 charges, up from 28
